shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin surges past $77K, eyeing $80K target amidst eased geopolitical tensions.
Major altcoins like ORDI (+178%) and SIREN (+123%) experienced significant rallies.
Israel-Lebanon ceasefire expectations and Strait of Hormuz reopening boost global risk-on sentiment.
Ethereum processed a record 200.4M transactions in Q1 2026, yet its price lags behind this on-chain growth.
Charles Schwab launched spot Bitcoin and Ethereum trading, enhancing institutional adoption.
